title: CircleChange
tagline: A Dex platform without need to pay gas in native token , you can easily exchange your token in a newly created wallet or first time in another network
description:
we have all experienced when we want to swap our token but don't have a native token to pay for gas, so what should we do? go into another wallet and send  a little native token 
but here with ezSwap we can exchange our token and pay for the gas with the token that we want to sell
with Account Abstraction modules of Safe Global (relay kit) we built a UniswapV2 DEX that you can use for exchange
how_its_made:
It's a Dex that is deployed with Uniswap-V2 bytecodes. 
in the front end, users can send their transactions with Safe relay kit 
and the front end itself is built on top of another open-source project that built an Interface that can interact with Uniswap
smart contracts are in Solidity, 
front-end app is built with React, 
smart contract wallet is built with Safe, 
the relay kit use Gelato and 1Balance
